issues: Missing the continuous cost reduction clause "This costs X less to play. X equals the number of cards named Naterran Great Tree that left your field this turn." The spell damage ability is correct, but the card also needs a passive play-cost-reduction effect using a dynamic amount based on the number of Naterran Great Tree cards that left your field this turn. Implement support for a dynamic amount/condition tracking named cards that left your field this turn, then encode it with a passive playCostReduction ability.

The fanfare is encoded as noop but is implementable in part and should not be left as a stub. Replace the noop with effects that look at the top 5 cards, add up to 2 Machina followers not named Vice, Death Grip to hand, put the rest on the bottom of the deck, then optionally summon up to 2 Machina followers that cost 2 or less from your hand.

The first half of the fanfare needs new engine support because existing tutor/search operations do not support choosing up to 2 cards from the top 5 to hand while bottoming the rest. Implement a search/peek effect that can reveal and move up to N matching cards from looked-at cards to hand with remainder to deckBottom.

The last clause "You may summon up to 2 Machina followers that cost 2 or less from your hand" is missing and also lacks engine support. Implement an effect to select and summon up to N matching followers from hand to field.

Missing the continuous name-change clause "While this card is on the field, its name is also Puppet." Add a passive ability that grants this card an additional identity/name while on the field. Implement engine support for passive on-field alternate-name effects, then encode this clause as a passive ability.

The Strike ability is missing the target selection for the enemy follower. Encode it as damageFollowerAndLeader with the required target selector for 1 enemy follower, so the effect matches "Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 3 damage to it and its leader."
